ValidationRule.description: To restrict Lead Status of "Qualified" to MDA Case#13007371
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Status), ISNEW() ), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Qualified"), $UserRole.Name <> "IME Teleprospecting", $UserRole.Name <> "IRON MTN ADMIN", $UserRole.Name <> "ICR", $UserRole.Name <> "MDA", $UserRole.Name <> "Team Lead - Interaction Center" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Qualified" status is reserved for marketing workflow automation. Select "Accepted" to further qualify, or convert lead to opportunity.
